description: Wspomagana rezygnacja z Whitepages. Użytkownik wykonuje kroki z listy zadań; OpenOptOut zapewnia jednorazowy adres e-mail i klika link potwierdzający.
instructions: Whitepages confirms by phone, so you need to do this one. Otwórz whitepages.com/suppression-requests, paste {listing_url}, press Next, then "Remove Me". Pick a reason, press Next, and enter the phone number Whitepages shows for you. Answer the automated call and enter the code it gives you. When the page says your request was received, press "I've done this".
